text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo conquers the Arima Kinen! The 
crowd buzzes in astonishment, and 
deafening cheers erupt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Long ago, even her debut was in jeopardy. 
Yet without giving up, she ran with all 
her might... and pulled off a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio calls Twin Turbo her "lifelong 
rival." And to an overjoyed Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tossed into the air in celebration by her 
friends. The little miracle floating in 
the sky was etched deeply into everyone's 
eyes.
